metadata.title: Mobile Data Containment

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for constraining the storage, movement, and sharing of institutional data within mobile environments.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Mobile application containers, operating system data isolation mechanisms, clipboard controls, file systems, and offline storage.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Foundational Zero Trust data protection pattern enforcing contextual, least‑privilege data exposure on mobile platforms.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Mobile Data Containment aligns with NIST guidance on information flow control, mobile data protection, and Zero Trust.

metadata.remarks: Mobile Data Containment defines the mandatory capabilities that restrict how institutional data is stored, accessed, and shared on mobile devices. This pattern assumes devices are hostile environments and enforces data-centric controls independent of device ownership.

components.title: Mobile Application Container Isolation
components.description: Ensures institutional data is confined to managed application containers and isolated from unmanaged or personal applications.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of application permissions to access or exfiltrate sensitive data.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Application containerization enforces data isolation between trust boundaries.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Information flow control restricts data movement between managed and unmanaged application contexts.
Boundary protection enforced between application containers.

components.title: Mobile Clipboard and Data Sharing Control
components.description: Restricts copying, pasting, and sharing of institutional data from managed mobile applications to unauthorized destinations.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Transfer of data to external or unauthorized applications.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Content control policies prevent unauthorized data transfer.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Security attributes are enforced to regulate data sharing.
Restrictions on data transfer via mobile interfaces.

components.title: Mobile Offline Data Protection
components.description: Controls the storage, encryption, and lifetime of institutional data stored locally on mobile devices.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Access to sensitive data on lost or stolen mobile devices.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Encrypted storage and controlled caching protect offline data.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Institutional data is encrypted at rest on mobile devices.
Data recovery and loss prevention controls address mobile offline risk.

components.title: Mobile Remote Data Disposal
components.description: Ensures institutional data can be selectively or fully removed from mobile devices upon risk triggers or lifecycle events.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Retention of sensitive data after authorization revocation.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Remote wipe and selective wipe eliminate residual data.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Media sanitization applied to mobile data stores.
Baseline configuration includes enforced data removal mechanisms.
